prompt: Create a Python 3.12 CLI calculator. It must support addition, subtraction, multiplication and division of two numbers. Display the result on the command line. Division by zero must produce a clear error message.

intentions.text: I can add two numbers and see the result displayed on the command line.
intentions.observable: the result of the addition is displayed on the command line

intentions.text: I can subtract the second number from the first and see the result displayed on the command line.
intentions.observable: the result of the subtraction is displayed on the command line

intentions.text: I can multiply two numbers and see the result displayed on the command line.
intentions.observable: the result of the multiplication is displayed on the command line

intentions.text: I can divide the first number by the second and see the result displayed on the command line.
intentions.observable: the result of the division is displayed on the command line

intentions.text: I get a clear error message when I try to divide by zero.
intentions.requires: a division operation with zero as the second number
intentions.observable: a clear error message is displayed indicating division by zero
